about_the_game:
Welcome

Hello! I'm Odd Ember, a solo developer and artist working on my own projects. Summona Realm is my very first project, and there’s still a lot of work ahead. But more than anything, I hope to bring an engaging story that everyone will enjoy. 

This story is divided into several parts, beginning with the first chapter, "The Secret Flame".

I hope it draws you in and leaves a lasting impression. Thank you for being here and supporting me.

Prologue...

This is the story of a peculiar man with a mysterious past, on the way to redeem his sins.

Though the tale unfolds with humor and cheerful moments, beneath it lies a deep sorrow, unanswered questions about what human is.

Yet, this is a journey of hope. A journey of self-discovery. It doesn’t promise all the answers but even through pain and despair, the light of hope shines brighter than anything else. 

Features

✦ Role-Playing

Step into the vast world of Summona through the eyes of Geroy, a mysterious protagonist with a hidden past. Explore and uncover its secrets through your journey.

✦ A Fresh Experience

Designed to bring the feeling of reading a manga, the game features a black-and-white visual style that sets it apart.

The special feature lies in a unique interaction system that allows you to navigate the story by selecting locations on the map.

Your choices matter : some locations can be revisited, and skipping certain points may cause you to miss some parts of the plot or entire branching storylines. Even the order of points selection can lead to different outcomes.

✦ Duration

The game is divided into 20 small chapters, with an estimated playtime of 10 to 12 hours.

Thanks to its interaction system, each playthrough can offer new discoveries, encouraging players to return and uncover paths they may have missed.

Additional Information

  • The game is still in development, so new chapters will be released gradually over time.

  • Additional language support may be added in future updates.

  • To prevent save file errors, the game is designed to be exited only through the “Quit” button.

  • The game is primarily presented from the perspective of the protagonist, Geroy. As a result, he does not often explain the details of this world, since he already possesses that knowledge. However, as players, we begin without this understanding. Therefore players need to watch events carefully, piece together the clues provided, and figure out how the world works.

Characters

✦ GEROY - THE PROTAGONIST

A Shaman, Geroy traveled across the Summona Realm continent before secluding in the Far-North Forest.

✦ KHUNDAJ - A BLACKSMITH WHO FORGES WEAPONS IN YULAV TOWN

A Tormo-gal blacksmith who forges weapons for Megikar, Khundaj traveled across the Summona Realm with Geroy five years ago before settling in the town of Yulav, where he opened a forge.

✦ USELEI - A MAGIC ITEM MERCHANT AND RESIDENT OF YULAV TOWN

A magic item merchant and resident of Yulav Town, Uselei is around 30 years old (she doesn’t like being asked about it).

✦ RAFF - THE OWNER OF THE LITTLE BLUE DRAGON TAVERN

The owner of the Little Blue Dragon Tavern in Yulav Town, Raff comes from the southern continent.

Content Warnings

While the game is not intended as 18+ content, it may include some suggestive or ecchi scenes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows7/8.1/10
  • Processor: Core i3 of Sandy Bridge generation or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics Series (It needs 1GB memory allocation)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 450 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Devices compatible Direct Sound
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 or better required (Recommended 1920x1080)

Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows7/8.1/10 (64bit ver)
  • Processor: Core i5 of Ivy Bridge generation or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce (VRAM 1GB or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

  • Sound Card: Sound Devices compatible Direct Sound
